# Data model

Every table in the system, taken from the models themselves.

Two things to know before reading:

- **`StockMovement` is append-only.** Quantity on hand is the sum of its rows.
  Nothing edits a balance; everything writes movements. See ADR 0001.
- **Raw materials, prepared components and dishes are all `Item`**, differing
  only by `kind`. One recursive routine explodes a sale down to raw
  materials. See ADR 0002.

### ProductionInput

What actually went into the batch. Deliberately separate from the recipe. If the formula is judged rather than measured -- and for batter it very often is -- the system records reality and compares it to the formula afterwards, instead of assuming the formula and producing confident, wrong numbers.

### ShiftEdit

Every correction to a clock record, kept forever. A time record that can be changed without trace is not a record.
